mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Actual Classic zoom field at scales 1 and 2 with repeated layout and unpublished canvas text. Escape discards valid 250% and invalid text drafts, restores 100%, leaves canvas physical width at 1000 pixels and preserves pending text/document/history. Tab still commits a valid 250% value without document history.

regression_baseline.result: The unchanged added probe failed before the fix: Escape left 250% displayed instead of restoring 100%. The expected baseline failure is archived separately from passing current logs.

scope: The percentage editor has a stable document-scoped ID and captures Escape before egui clears focus. Cancellation restores the current formatted percentage, clears the local dirty flag, releases focus and bypasses the focus-loss commit path. Existing arrow-key editing, Tab/Enter commit, percentage bounds and view action routing remain unchanged.
limits: This tests normal unmodified Escape while the percentage field is focused, not arbitrary coalesced native input or IME. Pending text is the existing unpublished canvas preview; retained editable text objects remain separate roadmap work. Native/rendered parity and latency remain unverified.
